summary.goal: Define the core domain entities (Plan, PlanVersion, Step) that form the foundation of the Planner system
summary.context: The domain model represents intent as structured, versioned specifications. Plans are immutable after approval, versions track changes, and steps form a DAG with AI-inferred dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan and PlanVersion entities are defined with TypeScript interfaces
Step entity supports scopes, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and gates
Version status transitions (draft -> approved -> published) are enforced
Structural diffs can be computed between versions
